powerGrid.note: No archived Marvel Universe wiki page for Peggy Carter. Wayback CDX prefix searches for Peggy_Carter, Carter,_Peggy, Margaret_Carter, Carter,_Margaret, Peggy, Captain_Carter and Agent_Carter returned nothing; only Sharon Carter's page exists.

powerOrigins.detail: No superpowers: trained as an agent by the Daughters of Liberty, she fought with the French Resistance, served in S.H.I.E.L.D. and qualified as a doctor.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 10 19

abilities.name: Marksman
abilities.detail: An expert shot with a range of high-powered firearms.

abilities.name: Combat training
abilities.detail: Highly skilled in close-quarters fighting and military tactics.

abilities.name: Communications officer
abilities.detail: Years with S.H.I.E.L.D. and other agencies made her a trained communications officer, the role she later filled for the Avengers.

abilities.name: Toxicology
abilities.detail: A trained medical doctor who could analyse a custom poison and craft its antidote within an hour.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Marvel Super-Heroes Vol 2 4

abilities.name: Multilingual
abilities.detail: Fluent in several languages, including English and French.

abilities.name: Dryad armour
abilities.detail: As Dryad she wore body armour that shielded her from a missile strike and insulated her while it burned.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 10 11

feats.text: As Resistance agent Agent 13 she took out a roomful of Nazi soldiers on her own, then helped Cap steal a German plane.
feats.where: Captain America and the First Thirteen Vol 1 #1 (May 2011)

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America and the First Thirteen Vol 1 1

feats.text: Waking from years of catatonia, she fought Faustus's henchmen beside Cap, threw a candlestick to free him and easily beat Dr. Wolfgang.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 1 162

feats.text: Made an antidote to Mindstorm's poison faster than her own 20 to 30 minute estimate, saving Spider-Man's life.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Marvel Super-Heroes Vol 2 4

feats.text: After Erskine's murder she shot the fleeing assassin in the arm, then chased his car into Brooklyn and shot the driver.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Captain America: The First Avenger

feats.text: Went alone after the Zodiac formula, beating a string of guards and stabbing a masked attacker who was strangling her in a gas-filled room.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Marvel One-Shot: Agent Carter

feats.text: Sprang an SSR ambush on Dottie Underwood's bank robbery and, after a fierce fight, knocked her out with a bag of money.
feats.where: Agent Carter, season 2, episode 1: The Lady in the Lake (2016)

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: The Lady in the Lake
